questions.scenario: Papa's old Activa scooter stops working midway on the road. What is your first instinct?

options.text: Grab the toolkit from the boot, check the spark plug, and try kicking it to start.
Wonder about the engine's thermal efficiency and why the mileage has been dropping lately.
Look at the old rusted body and imagine how cool it would look with a matte-black paint job and modified headlights.
Convince Papa it's time to sell it, quickly calculate its Olx exchange value, and plan which new scooter to buy.

questions.scenario: You are playing a racing game like Asphalt or Need for Speed. What is your absolute favorite part?

options.text: Tuning the engine, upgrading the exhaust, and installing the best turbocharger for maximum horsepower.
Comparing the top speed, acceleration graphs, and calculating the best nitro efficiency stats.
Spending hours in the garage customizing the paint job, neon underglow, and sporty alloy wheels.
Managing your garage's virtual money to unlock the most cars and build an unbeatable racing empire.

questions.scenario: Your cycle chain comes off while rushing to your evening tuition. How do you handle it?

options.text: Flip the cycle upside down, get your hands perfectly greasy, and set the chain back on the sprocket yourself.
Think about the tension in the chain and the gear ratio that caused the pedal to become so tight.
Notice how ugly the rusty chain looks and wish you had one of those sleek, gearless neon sports cycles.
Drag it to the local cycle-wala bhaiya to fix it quickly while you organize your tuition notes and call your friends.

questions.scenario: Your family is visiting a Maruti Suzuki or Hyundai showroom to buy a new car. What is your main input?

options.text: Opening the hood in the showroom to inspect the engine layout, battery placement, and wiring.
Asking the confused salesman about the CC, torque figures, and the car's aerodynamic drag coefficient.
Voting for the absolute best body color, premium dashboard finish, and stylish interior seats.
Calculating the on-road price, comparing insurance costs, and negotiating the delivery time with the dealer.

questions.scenario: It's the annual school science exhibition! What project are you presenting on your table?

options.text: A working hydraulic bridge made out of syringes, plastic pipes, and cardboard.
A detailed model explaining how aerodynamic shapes reduce air friction on bullet trains.
A beautifully crafted and painted clay model of a futuristic flying car concept.
You aren't just presenting; you are organizing the whole class's projects, assigning tables, and guiding the principal.

questions.scenario: You are traveling on the Vande Bharat Express. What fascinates you the most about the train?

options.text: How the heavy bogeys, suspension systems, and wheels handle the rough track joints so smoothly.
The regenerative braking system and how the massive electric motors achieve such high speeds.
The sleek, aerodynamic nose of the engine, the automatic sliding doors, and the premium seat design.
How the pantry timing, ticket checking, and station arrivals are perfectly coordinated like clockwork.

questions.scenario: You are watching a car race or rally on TV with your friends. What makes you yell at the screen the most?

options.text: The insanely fast 2-second pit stops where the mechanics flawlessly change all four tires.
The race strategy, fuel loads, and analyzing how tire degradation is affecting the lap times.
The aggressive aerodynamic wings and the incredibly cool liveries (colors) on the sports cars.
How the Team Principal manages the drivers' egos, talks to the sponsors, and handles the race budget.

questions.scenario: Your younger sibling drops and breaks their expensive remote-control car. What is your reaction?

options.text: Open it up with a tiny screwdriver, solder the broken wire back, and get the motor running again.
Test the battery voltage with a multimeter and figure out exactly which circuit shorted upon impact.
Take the broken plastic parts and glue them together to make a cool 'battle-damaged' showpiece.
Scold them, set strict rules for playing next time, and plan to buy a more durable one next Diwali.

questions.scenario: You are stuck in a massive traffic jam in your city. What are you thinking about while sitting in the car?

options.text: Listening to the engine idling and wondering if the clutch plates are wearing out from the stop-and-go traffic.
Thinking about the fuel combustion wastage and calculating how much more efficient an EV system would be here.
Looking at the cars around you and judging their headlight designs, grill shapes, and taillight LEDs.
Wishing there was a better traffic management system and planning a route that avoids this bottleneck entirely.

questions.scenario: Your school takes you on an industrial visit to a local manufacturing plant. What catches your eye the most?

options.text: The giant CNC machines cutting thick metal and the bright sparks flying from the welding stations.
The robotic arms on the assembly line and the complex physics algorithms controlling their precise movements.
The final product coming off the line, looking shiny, polished, and perfectly shaped for the customer.
The plant supervisor coordinating hundreds of workers, tracking assembly line speed, and enforcing safety protocols.

Mechanical_Technician.title: The Master Mechanic / Pit-Crew Pro
Mechanical_Technician.primary_match_text: You love getting your hands dirty! You are a practical problem solver who understands machines by touching, opening, and fixing them.
Mechanical_Technician.day_in_the_life: Wrenching on high-performance engines, testing mechanical prototypes in the workshop, and keeping heavy machines running at peak condition.
Mechanical_Technician.alternative_match_text: You are the friend everyone calls when their bike breaks down or a toy needs fixing. You'd also excel as a Hardware Engineer or Robotics Technician.
Mechanical_Technician.roadmap: 11th/12th PCM -> B.Tech Mechanical Engineering or Diploma in Automobile Engineering -> Participate in college SAE Baja/Supra competitions -> Hands-on industrial training.

R_and_D_Engineer.title: The Brainy Innovator / Thermodynamics Geek
R_and_D_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are the logic master! You don't just want to drive the car; you want to calculate the physics to make it 10x faster and more efficient.
R_and_D_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Running computer simulations (CAD/CAE), calculating heat transfers, and designing next-generation electric vehicle (EV) batteries or sustainable engines.
R_and_D_Engineer.alternative_match_text: The physics lover who mentally calculates the trajectory of a cricket ball. You'd also be great at Aerospace Engineering or Mechatronics.
R_and_D_Engineer.roadmap: 11th/12th PCM -> Crack JEE Mains/Advanced -> B.Tech Mechanical/Automobile Engineering -> M.Tech in Thermal Engineering or Mechatronics -> Join R&D labs.

Automotive_Designer.title: The Styling Maestro / Auto Designer
Automotive_Designer.primary_match_text: Aesthetics mean everything to you! You have a brilliant eye for sleek curves, cool interiors, and visualizing futuristic vehicle concepts.
Automotive_Designer.day_in_the_life: Sketching concept cars on an iPad, creating 3D clay models, and deciding the aerodynamics and visual identity of tomorrow's vehicles.
Automotive_Designer.alternative_match_text: The artist whose rough notebooks are filled with sketches of sports cars and bikes. You would also thrive as an Industrial Designer or Product Designer.
Automotive_Designer.roadmap: Any Stream in 11th/12th (PCM preferred) -> Clear UCEED/NID Entrance Exam -> B.Des (Bachelor of Design) in Industrial Design or Transportation Design.

Plant_Manager.title: The Boss / Production Maestro
Plant_Manager.primary_match_text: You are a born leader! You love organizing chaos, managing people, and ensuring complex systems run smoothly like a well-oiled machine.
Plant_Manager.day_in_the_life: Overseeing a massive factory floor, managing the supply chain, ensuring worker safety, and making sure thousands of cars are produced on time.
Plant_Manager.alternative_match_text: The class monitor who perfectly organizes events. Your business mindset would also make you an excellent Supply Chain Manager or Entrepreneur.
Plant_Manager.roadmap: 11th/12th PCM or Commerce with Math -> B.Tech (Mechanical/Industrial Engineering) or BBA -> MBA in Operations or Supply Chain Management (e.g., from IIMs or NITIE).
